cohort: Women giving birth at Karolinska University Hospital site Huddinge in Stockholm between January 1, 2019, and August 31, 2021.
finding: The midwifery continuity of care (MCoC) model was associated with fewer medical interventions and improved pregnancy outcomes, including a reduced risk of preterm birth.
mod_finding: Women in the MCoC model were more likely to give birth spontaneously and less likely to have an elective cesarean on maternal request.
